answer.rationale: With the contract expiring in 14 days and the line operating at 94% of committed volume, continuity has unusually high value and a primary-vendor switch or deferred decision could create unacceptable delivery exposure. I intend to negotiate renewal terms with the incumbent, using market benchmarking to pursue the mandated cost reduction while preserving the proven integration and delivery continuity. The 18% spend-cut target may not be fully achievable through price alone, so this remains contingent on verified incumbent performance and negotiation headroom.
